candidates.text: SEPARATE AMENDMENTS TO WORK WITH COUNCILOR MURPHY, UH, TO SUPPORT HEALTH SCREENINGS, WELLNESS PROGRAMS FOR OUR FIRST RESPONDERS INCLUDING THE POLICE DEPARTMENT, THE FIRE DEPARTMENT AND THE EMS.
BUT WHEN A UNION IS RAISING MONEY ON THEIR OWN SO THAT THEIR MEMBERS CAN UM, GET THE SCREENINGS THEY NEED MY FRIENDS WE HAVE A PROBLEM AND WE CAN'T ACCEPT THAT.

ALTHOUGH NOT ADOPTED BY THE STATE, THE BOSTON FIRE DEPARTMENT USES NFPA 1580 STANDARD FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND WELLNESS AS A NATIONALLY RECOGNIZED FRAMEWORK FOR PROTECTING OUR GREATEST RESOURCE OUR
FEDERALLY, AFG GRANTS HAVE HELPED FUND A NEW MENTAL HEALTH INITIATIVE TO HELP MEMBERS IN CRISIS.
THEY RESPOND TO TRAGEDY TRAUMA CRISIS.
ADDITIONAL TRAINING ON GROUP AND INDIVIDUAL CRISIS INTERVENTION AND SUICIDE PREVENTION.
OUR PEER SUPPORT COORDINATORS HAVE LOGGED 136 INDIVIDUAL INSTANCES OF SUPPORT RANGING FROM CHECK INS AND REFERRALS TO CRISIS INTERVENTION.

AND HOPEFULLY THIS YEAR HOPEFULLY THIS YEAR WHEN WE PUT MONEY IN THE BUDGET FOR, UH, NEW EQUIPMENT THAT THE FIREFIGHTERS WEAR WITHOUT THAT CANCER CAUSING AIDS AND THAT THE COUNCIL WILL VOTE FOR IT AND THAT IT WILL GO THR
FOR THE MOST PART EVERYTHING ON THE FIRE DEPARTMENT SAFETY HEALTH AND WELLNESS CRISIS GRANT FUNDED.
THAT THEY WERE CONCERNED WERE AFFECTING THEIR OVERALL HEALTH.
COMPILING THIS RISK EARLY DETECTION OF HEART DISEASE TRANSFORMED IT FROM AN EMERGENCY CRISIS INTO A MANAGEABLE HEALTH CONDITION.

EARLY DETECTION DETECTION IN EARLY IN HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE CHOICES BENEFIT NOT JUST THE EMPLOYEES, THEIR FAMILIES, THE DEPARTMENT IN THE CITY AND IT IS SOMETHING THAT WE ACTUALLY PUT ON THE TABLE THAT WAS DENIED.
YOU KNOW, OUR BUDGET PRIORITIES THAT WE DO EVERY YEAR AND WHAT WE ADVOCATE FOR, WHAT THE ADMINISTRATION SENDS OVER TO US AND WHAT'S FINALLY VOTED ON IS A VALUE STATEMENT.
IF IT'S NOT RECOMMENDED IT'S NOT GETTING APPROVED.
THAT INVESTMENT IS DEFINITELY GOING TO BE LESS THAN WHAT THE HEALTH INSURANCE COST WENT UP IN THIS LAST YEAR WHEN YOU GUYS.
$3 MILLION TO GIVE SOMEONE CANCER SCREENING NEW EQUIPMENT IS NOT A LOT OF MONEY COMPARED TO THE BILLION DOLLAR BUDGET THAT WE PASSED I CAN'T UNDERSTAND AND LIKE I SAID MAYBE IT'S ME.
